name: Kanai Mamiko
source: A math professor who started work at your school the same time as Chieri. They've been friends since their college days, though, unlike Chieri, her bright personality and carefree attitude have won her plenty of welcome companionship. She enjoys her role as Chieri's mentor in the ways of the world, and her sexy looks make her quite popular among the students.[from [url=http://www.jastusa.com/cherry/characters/characters.html]official English site[/url]]
